change Panthers to Carolina Panthers, and note the crowd was forty five thousand, give or take.

judge.criteria: Document should render a clear heading, then paragraphs, then a bulleted/numbered stats list; convert spoken numbers to figures (e.g., 2026, 21–17, 284, 48/32/29, 45,000, 2–0); apply the self-correction to use seven (not ten); omit disfluencies and spoken command phrases.
